prior_state: No v2 assessment reserved or executed; historical v1 pool is preserved and excluded.
multiplicity: Holm step-down familywise alpha 0.05 across the three secondary escape tests, regardless of primary outcome. No claim of one combined family across primary and secondary questions.

binary_reporting.paired_interval: Conservative 95% exact-binomial rectangle interval: q=P(discordance), theta=P(left-only | discordance); separate 97.5% Clopper-Pearson intervals, transform rectangle extrema q*(2*theta-1). Union bound gives at least 95% joint coverage, including zero discordances.
binary_reporting.secondary_simultaneous_intervals: Additionally use alpha=0.05/3 in the paired rectangle construction for three Bonferroni simultaneous intervals (pointwise coverage 98.333%).
binary_reporting.other_binary_tests: Report unadjusted exact McNemar tests for death, timeout, door and two-key completion as exploratory only; no confirmatory conclusions from them.

prediction.requirement: Only call matched experience if all paired action/world/enemy and map/localization hashes match. Otherwise investigate and report failure; do not relabel on-policy differences as learning.
prediction.uncertainty: 10000 paired whole-episode bootstrap draws; recompute sums/counts per draw. Report loss difference and relative reduction with 95% percentile intervals. Prediction intervals are prespecified estimation, not additional confirmatory p-value tests.
prediction.learning_curve: 25-step bins, paired-episode bootstrap, pointwise 95% intervals, episode and target counts. Late bins are conditional on survival; no simultaneous-band or monotone-learning claim.

continuous_reporting: Task, keys, model score, all forecast losses, unconditional episode steps and runtime reported separately. Successful-escape steps and runtime are conditional on success. Runtime is host wall time including replay auditing in the kernel but excludes post-episode hashing; concurrent runtime is not CPU work.

bootstrap.finite_denominators: Drop zero-denominator resamples per metric and report retained count.

interventions: record initial/final exported weight vectors and parameter constancy
compare exported positions with true relative location
compare visible mapped terrain with true current terrain
compare full fixed-risk trajectories and map/localization hashes
checkpointing: Atomic completed six-condition case files, case-index pairing, rotate condition order by case modulo six. Resume only against identical manifests.
invalid_episodes: Retain as failures (non-escape), report error and invalid counts; never replace unfavorable cases. If infrastructure prevents execution, preserve partial records and investigate; any reruns must be explicitly reported.
stopping: Finish all 1024 paired mazes regardless of intermediate results. No sample enlargement, agent tuning, evaluator changes or additional evolutionary slots.
progress: Descriptive completion/rate/intervention checks only; compute inferential tests after all 6144 episodes are saved.
examples: After analysis closure, choose the lowest case index in each selected-versus-frozen escape stratum: selected-only, frozen-only, both fail, both escape. Report missing strata. Rerun only these fixed cases to obtain display traces; verify against saved metrics/hashes. Publish compact examples with their seeds as exposed cases, excluded from future fresh testing.
